name: uk.co.sisoco/uk-companies-house-ownership
title: Sisoco One
description: No sign-up. Check + monitor UK companies, PSC owners, KYB: Companies House, Sirene, LEI, insolvency.

tools.name: sisoco_check_company
tools.description: Start here. Resolves a UK company number, French SIREN, LEI, or a company name with country (GB or FR) to one company, and returns its identity, current signals (e.g. accounts overdue, insolvency notice, sanctions possible match for the company or its GLEIF direct and ultimate parents) and events of the last 90 days, each with its official source URL. A name that matches several companies returns error ambiguous_match with ranked candidates; call again with a candidate's number. Facts from official registers, never a score or a verdict; sanctions results are possible matches that need the user's own review. Cost: 1 lookup from the monthly quota (same as GET /v1/check). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

company.description: Registry number (e.g. 00445790, SIREN 552032534), LEI, or a company name

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (GB, FR); needed for name searches

tools.name: sisoco_company_officers
tools.description: Lists the officers of a UK company as published by Companies House: directors, secretaries and LLP members, with role, appointment and resignation dates, nationality, occupation, country of residence and month and year of birth. Current officers have resigned_on null; former officers are included with their resignation date. Use it for KYB checks on who runs a company. Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/companies/uk/{company_number}/officers). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456; short numbers are zero-padded

tools.name: sisoco_get_lei_parents
tools.description: Returns the direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents reported to GLEIF (Level 2) for a Legal Entity Identifier, each with its LEI and name, or the reason no parent is reported (e.g. NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_CONSOLIDATING, NO_KNOWN_PERSON). Works for any country. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/entities/lei/{lei}/parents). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

tools.name: sisoco_get_lei_record
tools.description: Returns the GLEIF record for a Legal Entity Identifier: legal name, registered and headquarters addresses, legal form, registration authority and number, entity and registration status (e.g. LAPSED). For its parent companies call sisoco_get_lei_parents. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/entities/lei/{lei}). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

tools.name: sisoco_ownership_chain
tools.description: Who owns and controls a UK company, up to its ultimate owners: reads the company's register of persons with significant control (Companies House), then the registers of its UK corporate owners, level by level, with cycle protection. Each link gives the kind of control as published, coded and in plain words (e.g. "owns 75% or more of the shares", "can appoint and remove a majority of the directors"). If the register lists no current owner, no_owners_reason says why in plain words (e.g. a listed company exempt under the FCA's DTR 5 rules, or a PSC statement such as "owner exists but not identified"). Individuals are returned by name only, as published. If unread_owner_ids is not empty, call again with one of those owners' company numbers to go further. Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/companies/uk/{company_number}/ownership-chain). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456; short numbers are zero-padded

tools.name: sisoco_recent_events
tools.description: Recent events stored for one entity, newest first, each with its type, severity, official source and source URL; event types are those of the packs this key can use. Pass the entity id (ent_…) returned by a check or lookup. An empty list means no events were recorded in the window, not that nothing happened. Cost: 1 lookup from the monthly quota (same as GET /v1/entities/{entity_id}/events). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

entity_id.description: Entity id (ent_…) as returned by check or a lookup

tools.name: sisoco_search_company
tools.description: Searches the Companies House register (UK) by name or number and returns matching companies with number, status and address. Use it to find the company number to pass to sisoco_check_company or sisoco_ownership_chain. For French companies call sisoco_check_company with the name and country FR. Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/companies/uk/search). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).
